appearance_facts.fact: x-axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 1960 to 2020.
Red dashed line with square markers represents Urban percentage. It peaks around 1970 at 12.57% and declines to 12.12% by 1980, then rises slightly before falling sharply after 2000.
Blue solid line with circular markers represents Rural percentage. It starts low in 1960, rises steadily to 44.20% by 1980, and continues increasing to 46.32% by 2000, then further to a high in 2020.
The red line has an annotation '12.12%' at the 1980 mark.
The red line has an annotation '12.57%' at the 1970 mark.

public_definitions: Review the public urban-rural population statistics dashboard, compare the 1990 percentage for Urban and Rural, then open the population category follow-up record for the category with the larger 1990 percentage.
